embedding_diagnostics.note: CodeBERT [CLS]-token embeddings exhibit anisotropy on this dataset: mean pairwise cosine similarity of 0.9833 across a 500-sample subset (min 0.8848, max 0.9996). This dilutes the 768-dim embedding block's discriminative signal relative to the 23-dim AST+metrics block. PCA-whitening the embeddings to 64 components (93.0% variance retained) recovers a small real improvement (XGBoost F1 0.5673 -> 0.5725) but was not adopted in production due to the added inference-pipeline complexity for a marginal gain.
